subtitle: UPDATE Aug 1, 13:49 BRT, 64 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). A SECOND CONSECUTIVE DAY OF A NEW TOP. Lula rose 1.00pp to 65.50% (vol USD 7.82M), the maximum of the AFOS series, which runs from Apr 14 to today. Flávio Bolsonaro rose 0.40pp, to 24.75% (vol USD 7.79M), and even so the gap WIDENED from +40.15pp to +40.75pp, also the maximum of the series that holds both names, which begins on May 3. Both records were broken on Jul 31 and broken again today, and on both occasions with the opponent rising alongside: the move is demand for the front-runner and not deterioration on the other side. RENAN SANTOS fell 0.55pp and went to 7.60% (vol USD 8.72M), his lowest value since May 14. The fall is one of sequence, not of a single session: on Jul 23 he stood at 12.00% and has since given ground in eight of nine rounds, adding up to 4.40pp. Before May 14 the series records lower values, which is why the window is declared and the panel does not write "of the series". THE WHOLE CHASING PACK SHRANK: Caiado fell 0.25pp, to 1.35% (vol USD 5.24M), Jair Bolsonaro fell 0.30pp, to 0.55%, Alckmin fell 0.10pp, to 0.35%, and CAMILO SANTANA gave back everything he had gained the day before, falling 0.90pp to 0.45% (vol USD 4.19M), which is his lowest value in the AFOS series, below the 0.50% of Jul 30. Tarcísio de Freitas appears at 0.05% in the presidential contract, with USD 13.69M of accumulated volume, the largest in the book. The panel records the level and does not claim it is his lowest: the AFOS series holds only three days for that name, between Apr 28 and May 14, and does not support a superlative. IN THE PLACING BOOKS, Flávio rose 1.00pp in first-round second place, to 79.50%, while Renan gave up 0.80pp, to 8.55%, and in third place Caiado COLLAPSED 5.00pp, from 27.50% to 22.50% (vol USD 37,000), undoing in one session the gain the panel recorded yesterday. On ticket-building, Flávio Bolsonaro remains without a running mate four days from the Aug 5 deadline. Tereza Cristina publicly regretted the end of the arrangement after the PP's refusal, saying that what happened is settled, and he thanked her and said he is negotiating with other parties. On Saturday, Republicanos made official Tarcísio de Freitas's bid for RE-ELECTION as governor of São Paulo, with Flávio present on the platform, but Tarcísio himself kept the focus on the state and avoided nationalizing his speech. These are distinct things and the panel does not merge them: Saturday's convention is a state one and deals with the São Paulo governorship; the party's national convention, which decides the presidential alliance, is set for Aug 4. ON THE JUDICIAL AXIS, André Mendonça authorized on the afternoon of Jul 31 a SECOND inquiry into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, this time over his dealings with Dataprev, after the first one, over the Health Ministry, authorized on Jul 30. The national poll remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, field Jul 26 to 28, margin of 2.15pp, 95% confidence, BR-01084/2026), with no new national round since then. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 117.52M. The double-reading capture guard failed the first round, with Renan Santos in transit from 7.15% to 7.60% and Caiado's third-place book swinging between 22.00% and 22.50%, and APPROVED the second. All prices go in firm, with no declared range. Live capture Aug 1, 16:49 UTC.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: Polymarket 65.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.82M accumulated), 64 days to the election, at the MAXIMUM of the AFOS series for a second consecutive day. The gap over Flávio widens to +40.75pp, also a series maximum. No new national poll: the latest remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100), with 40.5% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47.5% x 41.1% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno).
fortes: He PASSED his own top for a second consecutive day, going from 64.50% to 65.50%, the highest value in the AFOS series, which runs from Apr 14 to today.
Vox Brasil gives 47.5% x 41.1% in the runoff, and the 6.4pp fall OUTSIDE the two margins added together, so this reading does NOT describe a statistical tie.
Two of the week's three houses measure the first-round gap around 9pp, 9.1pp at AtlasIntel and 9.3pp at Vox, and the one that departs is PoderData, with 6pp.
The PCdoB formalized support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket, adding to the PSB, which made Alckmin the running mate official on Jul 29.
The institute records that, between May and July, Lula gained 7.3pp and Flávio lost 2.7pp within its own series, reversing a lead that had belonged to the senator.
fracos: The gap of +40.75pp is a series maximum, but it widened on a day when Flávio ALSO rose 0.40pp, which rules out a reading of deterioration of the opponent.
The 40.5% at Vox in the first round remain below 50% plus one vote, meaning the reading describes a runoff and not a first-round win.
The Vox round did NOT publish approval or rejection, so the evaluation picture remains the one from Jul 30, with two houses pointing in opposite directions in the same week.
The 40.5% fall below the 44.9% AtlasIntel measured on Jul 29, and comparing different houses does not license calling that a decline.
The price did not react to any of the week's three national polls, which leaves the panel with no evidence that the market is reading them at all.
candidates.analise: His day repeated yesterday's and went further. The winner contract ROSE 1.00pp and went to 65.50% (vol USD 7.82M), a second series top in two sessions, and the gap WIDENED to +40.75pp, also a maximum. On both days the move came with Flávio rising alongside, which describes demand for the front-runner and not deterioration on the other side. NO NEW POLL. No national poll has been published since Vox Brasil of Jul 31, so the price moved 2.00pp across two sessions with no voting-intention reading to accompany it. It is the fifth session in nine days where this happens, and the panel records the asymmetry without explaining it. IN HIS CAMP, the market undid the previous day's move: Camilo Santana gave back 0.90pp and went to 0.45%, his lowest value in the AFOS series, below the 0.50% of Jul 30, and Alckmin gave up 0.10pp, to 0.35%. The easy reading would be to tie this to yesterday's PCdoB backing, and the panel does not: the formal support still stands and the price returned to its starting point within 24 hours. ON THE PARTY CALENDAR, the PT makes his candidacy official at a national convention this Sunday, Aug 2, after state conventions in Ceará on Jul 31 and in Bahia today. And his camp took a new judicial fact: on the afternoon of Jul 31, André Mendonça authorized a SECOND inquiry into Lulinha, now over his dealings with Dataprev, a day after the first. An inquiry is not a conviction and the panel does not treat it as one.
